Body.Content:
We are announcing the ability to enrich insights with Microsoft Teams meeting transcripts in Dynamics 365 Sales. This feature will reach general availability on August 30, 2026.

How does this affect me?
This feature enables the Sales opportunity agent to connect with your Microsoft Teams meetings and derive insights, risks, and next steps from those meetings. This additional data source helps to provide sellers with a more holistic list of actions and insights.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

Title: Dynamics 365 Sales - Enrich insights with Teams meeting transcripts
